pages.title: TR-0
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA NAME REVIEW$()$(br)From: Supervisor, Vault Stores$(br)Re: TR-0 Terminus, informal designation$(br2)All three shifts are logging the TR-0 as the $(italic)deathwand$(). They say the name comes from some old book going round the rec room.

pages.title: Disposition
pages.text: Terminus is the catalogue name. A formal name review was requested so the matter could be closed.$(br2)$(italic)DENIED.$()$(br2)No review board will sit for an item with no issuing division. Log it as the TR-0, and stop lending out the book.
